Intercept supported BF16 single-token expert input; call the original method directly for prefill/unsupported shapes to prevent fallback recursion. Restore the exact original method between candidate and baseline requests and on every exit. No source-file mutation.

Fresh20-pair A/A confidence calibration before matched20-pair baseline/candidate comparisons with five warmups; preserve fixed per-request controls and paging-aware policy. Do not compare new candidate against historical baseline numbers. No old failed calibration relabeled.

Prepare all24 layers outside the timed request and record every setup duration, active memory and transient peak separately.
